items: 2 × 10 oz cans cream of chicken soup

steps.title: Heat the broth
steps.body: Heat together in large pot: **3 tsp chicken soup base** and **3 cups water**.

steps.title: Simmer the vegetables
steps.body: Add **2 cups chopped carrots**, **2 cups chopped celery** and **¾ cup chopped onion**, and simmer until tender.

steps.title: Add the rest
steps.body: Add **2 × 10 oz cans cream of chicken soup**, **¼ cup evaporated milk**, **2 cups diced chicken** and **4 cups (about 1½ ounces) cooked egg noodles**. Salt and pepper to taste.
